sources.title: OSS Personnel Files from Excel
sources.locator: PDF page 368, rows 24-46; visually checked against a 300 dpi render
sources.collection_name: Records of the Office of Strategic Services, Record Group 226
sources.rights_notes: Every printed row remains separate. Full protected identifiers remain private. Santo Piazza's 'French,' Edward Pichette's 'Also Fra,' Adrian Pickering's 'Also 313,' and India Pickett's 'Also 601' notes remain literal. Sidney R Pickus also appears on PDF page 369, row 1; both rows are preserved and linked to one cautiously resolved person.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Lawrence Pickard row is linked at high confidence to the Yonkers journalist and 82nd Airborne officer documented in two independent sources.
claims.evidence_excerpt: LAWRENCE PICKARD, released from duties as first lieutenant with the 82d Airborne Division
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A contemporary trade journal and a later obituary independently agree on Yonkers and 82nd Airborne details; the indexed officer rank is compatible with promotion.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from exact name plus two corroborating identifiers beyond the name: Yonkers association and 82nd Airborne service, supported independently.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources establish wartime identity and a pre-Army civilian affiliation; they do not establish the immediate pre-OSS assignment.
claims.match_notes: The index has 2d Lt while the February 1946 source says first lieutenant; the promotion is chronologically compatible and is not treated as a conflict.

claims.claim_text: Lawrence Pickard's last documented civilian employer before Army service was the Yonkers Herald-Statesman.

claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded as the last documented civilian affiliation before Army service; not shown to be the immediate pre-OSS affiliation.
claims.match_notes: The source says 'was with' and does not give a job title, so no role more specific than journalism is assigned.
